name: Render Live Execution Monitor
description: Renders a live execution monitor showing task progress, status badges, task log table, and streaming code output. Updates in real-time as the execution trace changes.

tasks.description: Extract progress data from the execution trace

config.command: echo '{{activity_execution_trace}}' | bun -e "const t=JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()); const tasks=t.tasks||[]; const done=tasks.filter(x=>x.status==='completed'||x.status==='failed').length; console.log(JSON.stringify({done,total:tasks.length,status:t.status,tasks}));"

tasks.description: Produce a ui_component impulse with progress bar, status badges, and task log
